job.question: What is the proposal submission deadline in the Oklahoma Public Employees Retirement System (OPERS) investment consulting services RFP?
job.acceptance: Accept Central Time/CT; explicit equivalent timezone conversion acceptable.

reviews.reason: The document is a 2024 Missouri LAGERS private market consulting RFP, not the Oklahoma OPERS investment consulting services RFP. Its proposal deadline does not support the requested deadline.
quotes: Missouri Local Government Employees Retirement System (LAGERS) is issuing this Request for Proposal (RFP) for the purpose of soliciting qualified firms to provide private market consulting services.
The response deadline for this RFP is 5pm Central time on July 26, 2024.
